summary: Master advanced operations management essentials. Learn Lean Six Sigma, ISO 9001, and SCOR models to optimize efficiency and risk. Enroll for expert-led trainin
lede: Operations management covers how experienced professionals direct processes that turn resources into goods and services. Learners practice capacity planning and bottleneck analysis, map workflows, and apply quality and continuous-improvement methods to operational problems. The course also explores supply-chain synchronization and risk planning for professionals responsible for improving operations, production, quality, or supply-chain performance.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is tailored for experienced professionals responsible for the strategic and operational performance of complex value chains.
modules: Advanced Process Design and Capacity Planning
Quality Management Systems and ISO Standards
Lean Six Sigma and Continuous Improvement
Supply Chain Synchronization and SCOR Model
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in an operations, supply chain, or quality management role. A working knowledge of basic statistical concepts and familiarity with ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle) is required. No prior coding knowledge is necessary, but participants must be comfortable using Excel for data analysis exercises.
